text.p: STOCKHOLM, July 7 ( Reuter) - Factfile on Wilson Kipketer who equalled the men's 800 metres world record of one minute 41.73 seconds at the Stockholm Grand Prix on Monday:
Born, Sparta, Kenya December 12, 1970. Went to live in Denmark in 1990 and was ranked world number one over 800 in 1994.
In 1995 won the world title in Gothenburg for Denmark but was not allowed to compete at last year's Atlanta Olympics following a protest over his nationalty from the Kenyan Athletics Federation.
Broke the world indoor record twice at the Paris indoor world championships last March.
